source.name: IRS Statistics of Income — US Population Migration Data, 2022-2023

notes: IRS SOI US Population Migration Data, filing years 2022-2023 (files …2223.csv)
US moves only (the IRS's own Total Migration-US subtotal); foreign flows dropped so inflow and outflow are the same universe
AGI is thousands of dollars, exactly as published — columns carrying it are named _agi_k
county-migration.csv: all 3087 counties with both directions published (33 dropped for a missing direction); totals are the IRS's own, never a sum of pairs
state-migration.csv: 51 rows — the 50 states and DC — including the non-migrant (stayers) row, which is the leavers-versus-stayers comparison
the two grains measure different universes and do NOT add up: a county's total counts every US move including within its own state, while a state's total counts only moves ACROSS state lines
state-flows.csv: the 6 largest destinations out of each state, 306 corridors of 2544 published, 50.6% of households moving between states
county-pairs.csv: the 3 largest destinations out of each state, 153 corridors, 9.7% of households moving between published county pairs

the app's committed county atlas (vendor/geo/counties-albers-10m.json) predates the 2022 boundary changes, so 11 counties in this data have no shape to draw: 02063 Chugach, AK; 02066 Copper River, AK; 09110 Capitol Planning Region, CT; 09120 Greater Bridgeport Planning Regio, CT; 09130 Lower Connecticut River Valley Pl, CT; 09140 Naugatuck Valley Planning Region, CT; 09150 Northeastern Connecticut Planning, CT; 09160 Northwest Hills Planning Region, CT; 09170 South Central Connecticut Plannin, CT; 09180 Southeastern Connecticut Planning, CT; 09190 Western Connecticut Planning Regi, CT. They are kept — dropping them would delete Connecticut's whole county coverage, since its eight counties were replaced by nine planning regions the atlas has never had
the IRS truncates its county-name field at 32 characters and this extract does not repair it

IRS disclosure suppression: 0 state pairs and 0 county pairs came through as -1 and were excluded rather than zeroed. In this vintage that is none of them, because the IRS pools what it cannot publish into its own "Other flows" pseudo-rows, which are dropped as subtotals rather than places — the guard stays because other vintages do publish -1
county names drop the type word (County/Parish/Borough/Census Area/Municipality/Municipio), the same convention as the Market Coverage pack
